title: The Meeting Comes Off the Page
label: ch:ur-script-meeting
canDo: I can read aam, aasmaan, purana, aap, voh and hun off the page, name a non-joining letter on sight, and write the opening meeting exchange from dictation.

payoff.summary: The exchange the book opens with -- salam, aap ka naam kya hai, mera naam ... hai, aap kaise hain, main ... hun -- is readable and writable end to end for the first time, on letters taught across chapters one to eight.
